name: OCBC 365 Credit Card

extra.summary: The OCBC 365 Credit Card is best for families and individuals focused on maximizing everyday spending. The decent cashback rates on dining (5%), groceries, land transport, recurring bills, petrol (up to 6%), and Watsons purchases make it ideal for daily essentials. Meeting the minimum spend of S$800 unlocks these benefits, though maximizing the S$160 cashback cap requires a higher S$1,600 spend.

minimum-income-requirements.Singaporean/PR Minimum Annual Income:
•At least S$30,000 for Singaporeans and Singapore PRs aged between 21 and 54
•At least S$15,000 for Singaporeans and Singapore PRs aged 55 and above

our_takes.our-take: The OCBC 365 Credit Card is best for families and individuals focused on maximizing everyday spending. The decent cashback rates on dining (5%), groceries, land transport, recurring bills, petrol (up to 6%), and Watsons purchases make it ideal for daily essentials. Meeting the minimum spend of S$800 unlocks these benefits, though maximizing the S$160 cashback cap requires a higher S$1,600 spend. Consider if your spending aligns with these categories and if you can consistently hit the spend thresholds to make the most of the rewards.
our_takes.good-for:
Families seeking cashback on everyday expenses like groceries, petrol, dining, and recurring bills to offset household costs.
Individuals who frequently use ride-hailing services and public transport, aiming to earn cashback on their daily commutes.
Streaming enthusiasts and those with recurring telco bills who want to earn rewards while enjoying their favorite entertainment.
our_takes.things-to-note:
Without S$800 monthly spend, you only earn 0.25% cashback, heavily reducing potential rewards.
A high 27.78% interest rate applies if you don't pay your balance in full monthly.
Late payment fees are S$100; always pay on time to avoid these hefty charges.
